handover_report.title: EverythingAI — Client/Admin UX Clarity Progress Handover

repository.name: everythingAI
repository.working_branch_policy: All work happens directly on main unless the user explicitly changes this rule.

source_of_truth_before_this_work.status: Local MVP hardening validated; manual UI smoke test in progress.

problem_observed_by_user: Client and Admin UI were visually too similar and did not clearly identify the current workspace type.
It was unclear when the user was exploring raw files/file content versus the saved Knowledge Base.
The chat view did not auto-scroll to the latest sent/received message.
Admin UI needed to clearly identify itself as the operator/admin control surface.

implemented_work.summary: Added CLIENT WORKSPACE badge, renamed navigation labels to Home, Sources & Files, Knowledge Base, and Ask AI, and clarified safe client mode.
Added chat auto-scroll using a bottom ref and clarified that Ask AI is for the Knowledge Base and indexed source context.
Renamed user-facing Wiki language to Knowledge Base, clarified that this is a saved database generated from indexed file content, and renamed source labels to File Sources.
Clarified Sources & Files as the raw indexed files/extracted file content view, distinct from the generated Knowledge Base.
Added ADMIN DASHBOARD badge, changed Explorer nav label to Files & Content, and clarified provider pill wording.

Added ADMIN DASHBOARD hero label and clarified the admin page as the operator control center for source paths, indexing, extracted content, providers, planning rules, execution safety, analytics, and knowledge operations.

preserved_invariants: No trust-score or quality-score calculations changed.
Client UI remains a safe user workspace and does not expose provider/API-key configuration.
next_approved_actions: Review Client Workspace and Admin Dashboard screenshots after the patch.
If validation passes, record a validation addendum and continue the manual smoke test.
